details:
This update for cpupower fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-80663: tools/power/x86/intel-speed-select: Harden daemon pidfile open (bsc#1278335).

Changes for cpupower:

- intel-speed-select: Harden daemon pidfile open (git-fixes, bsc#1278335, CVE-2026-80663)
- turbostat: Fix microcode patch level output for AMD/Hygon (git-fixes)
- cpupower: Reset errno before strtoull() (stable-fixes)
- intel-speed-select: Fix file descriptor leak in isolate_cpus() (git-fixes)
- cpupower: Fix incorrect size in cpuidle_state_disable() (stable-fixes)
- cpupower: fix error return value in cpupower_write_sysfs() (stable-fixes)
- cpufreq: Fix a bug where the -t option of the set subcommand was not working (stable-fixes)
- turbostat: Clustered Uncore MHz counters should honor show/hide options (stable-fixes)
- turbostat: Handle non-root legacy-uncore sysfs permissions (stable-fixes)
- turbostat: Handle cap_get_proc() ENOSYS (stable-fixes)
- turbostat: Fix build with musl (stable-fixes)
- cpupower: Fix the snapshot-order of tsc,mperf, clock in mperf_stop() (stable-fixes)
- power turbostat: Fix bogus SysWatt for forked program (git-fixes)
- cpupower: bench: Prevent NULL dereference on malloc failure (stable-fixes)
